changelog:
- Hera's styles and scripts load as one stylesheet and one script, compressed once on the server: 3 requests instead of 28, and about a third fewer bytes.
- The web client page can be revalidated instead of downloaded in full.
- Person pages load the first 40 titles of each shelf and fetch the rest when you choose Show all.
- Watch statistics are totalled in the database and remembered for days that have ended, so long ranges open much faster.
- Opening Discover directly no longer loads the home hero's art behind it.
- Hidden titles, trailer checks and request lists after a new request are cached more carefully; old request records are tidied away after 180 days.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
